title: Wendell and the Rivergate
author: Bram Kavanagh
blurb: Emrys Ishikawa, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
